offers.name: Nutrition + Training Assessment
offers.fit: You want to understand your starting point before choosing ongoing coaching.
offers.promise: Get a clearer view of where you are now.
offers.description: A comprehensive, one-time assessment of your nutrition and training. Start with a focused review before deciding on your next level of support.
features: One-time service with no monthly subscription
offers.terms: One-time payment. Ongoing coaching is purchased separately.

offers.name: Online Coaching
offers.fit: You want a coach in your corner, wherever you train.
offers.promise: Turn your effort into a plan you can follow—and keep refining.
offers.description: Custom programming, check-ins and a nutrition protocol, with remote guidance built around your goals and training setup.
features: Train at your own gym or training setup
offers.terms: Billed monthly. Review the subscription terms at checkout.

offers.name: In-Person Coaching
offers.fit: You want a coach beside you on the gym floor.
offers.promise: Learn the movement. Build the skill. Train with direction.
offers.description: Full programming plus one coaching session each week at Strikeline in Beaufort, with hands-on technique and exercise guidance.
features: Train at Strikeline in Beaufort, SC
offers.terms: Billed monthly. A 30-day cancellation notice is required.

ownerDecision: User confirmed: Use the $175 assessment. The standalone training program is not included in this three-offer checkout set.
